verdicts.reason: Both share the same serious flaws. The search icon has been pulled out of the PPC CAMPAIGNS search bar and blown up into a huge, pixelated magnifier that becomes the main focal point, which leaves the search box with an empty right cell. The laptop photo is shrunk into a small inset with white margins on every side, so it no longer feels like the hero image it was. B is slightly better because its photo sits evenly in the white band, with about 25px above and below. In A the photo is about 10px from the orange band and leaves about 40px of white space at the bottom.
